visible_geometry: This large circular drawing has a ring of text on the outside and a T-O map in the centre. There are eight bands contining lines of writing, spiralling in from the outside circle to the T-O map. Approximately halfway between the T-O map and the large circle is a boundary drawn as a wavy line, also known as 'nebuly' or 'Wolkenband'. The area between the T-O map and this boundary is painted blue and has a number of stars painted yellow.
